items.title: What is a Foreign Customer Current Account?
items.content: A Foreign Customer Current Account is a payment account designed for foreign individuals, whether residing or non-residing in Vietnam. It enables customers to perform essential financial transactions such as receiving money, fund transfers, and daily payments.

items.title: What features does this account offer?
items.content:
This account allows customers to conveniently manage finances via the Vikki digital banking app, with key features including:
  • Fast fund transfers via account number or card number (intrabank and interbank)
  • Free bill payments (electricity, water), mobile top-up, and QR payments
  • Booking services (flight tickets, transportation, movies, hotels, golf, etc.) directly on the Vikki App
  • Loyalty rewards accumulation (SkyJoy) for redemption

items.title: What are the requirements to open an account?
items.content:
Customers must meet the following conditions:
  • Aged 15 or above with full or appropriate civil legal capacity
  • Registered Vietnamese phone number
  • Valid passport
  • Valid visa or proof of visa exemption (e.g. visa exemption certificate, temporary/permanent residence card)
  • Proof of lawful income or income declaration (if required)

items.title: What documents are required?
items.content:
You should prepare:
  • Passport
  • Visa / Temporary or Permanent Residence Card / Visa exemption documents
  • Proof of residence duration (if applicable)
  • Proof of income (if required)

items.title: What are the general transaction limits?
items.content:
Daily limits:
  • 18+: up to VND 500 million/day
  • 15 – under 18: up to VND 100 million/day
    Monthly limits:
  • 18+: from VND 500 million up to VND 3 billion/month (depending on income verification)
  • 15 – under 18: up to VND 500 million/month
